περαιτέρω 
(πέρα, beyond), 
compar. adv., 
beyond: Act.19.39, L, Tr., WH (T, Rec., R, περὶ ἑτέρων).†
(AS)

περι-άπτω, 
[in LXX: 3Ma.3.7 * ;] 
__1. to tie about, attach. 
__2. In late writers, to light a fire around, kindle: πῦρ, Luk.22.55.†
SYN.: θιγγάνω, ψηλαφάω. ἅ. is the stronger, θ., to touch, the lighter term. ψ. is to feel, as in search of something (Tr., Syn., § xvii; Lft., Col., 201 f.) (AS)

προσ-κλίνω 
[in LXX: 2Ma.14.24 * ;] 
__1. to make to lean against. 
__2. to make the scale incline one way or another; hence, metaphorically, of persons, to incline (sc. ἑαυτόν) towards: pass., Act.5.36.†
(AS)

1. grain, corn: food made from grain, bread , ποιεῖσθαι σιτία ἀπὸ ὀλυρέων to feed off spelt, (Herdotus Historicus)

3. τἀν Πρυτανείῳ σιτία public maintenance in the Prytaneum, (Aristophanes Comicus); compare σίτησις.
